x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change live-room-conference-system-link (REQ-RCSL-002 to REQ-RCSL-005, matrix row liv-22). The file is named 99- so it merges after every fragment that sets the Participant or Vote version (fragments merge in sorted name order). A member's seat in the chamber's conference and voting system is recorded on the participant (roomSeat). What the room system sends comes in as a RoomSystemMessage, an inbox only the integriq synchronisation group may create in; decidiq's RoomSystemMessageListener resolves the seat and applies a speech through EngagementService and a vote through VoteCastingService, so every voting rule stays in decidiq. Vote gains castVia, the channel a ballot came through. The synchronisation user reads meeting, agenda-item and participant through the register's own read rule (authenticated); no grant is added for that.

roomSeat.title: Seat in the room system
roomSeat.description: The delegate unit id the chamber's conference and voting system sends for this member's seat, such as 12.
roomSeat.x-notes: Matched exactly against RoomSystemMessage.seat by RoomSystemMessageService, among the participants of the meeting's governance body. Empty for a member without a seat.

castVia.title: Cast through
castVia.description: The channel the ballot came through.
castVia.x-notes: room-system is set by RoomSystemMessageService after VoteCastingService::castVote() saved the ballot of a desk vote.

RoomSystemMessage.title: Room system message
RoomSystemMessage.description: A speaker marking or a desk vote the chamber's conference and voting system sent, and whether decidiq applied it.
RoomSystemMessage._authorizationNote: Only the integriq synchronisation group creates messages; staff read them. Nobody updates or deletes through the object API: decidiq's RoomSystemMessageService writes status, rejectReason and participant in system context, after the listener (on create) or the chair or secretary (apply again) started it. A schema block replaces the register block whole, so the write actions left out stay closed.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A speaker marking or a desk vote.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: The delegate unit id as the room system sends it.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The agenda item a speech was on.

votingRound.title: Voting round
votingRound.description: The round a vote is for.

startedAt.title: Microphone on
startedAt.description: When the speaker's microphone went on, as the room system sends it.

endedAt.title: Microphone off
endedAt.description: When the speaker's microphone went off.

externalId.title: Room system message id
externalId.description: The room system's own id for this message; one message per id is applied in a meeting.

rejectReason.title: Reason
rejectReason.description: Why the message was not applied, in plain words for the clerk.

participant.title: Member
participant.description: The member the seat resolved to, written when the message is applied.
